name: Tomasz Pagowski. Remont u Ciebie
overview: Tomasz Pągowski. Remont u Ciebie (Tomasz Pągowski: Renovation at Your Place) is a Polish lifestyle and interior makeover series hosted by interior designer and presenter Tomasz Pągowski. Broadcast primarily on CANAL+ DOMO and CANAL+ Family, the show focuses on practical, fast-paced home transformations across Poland.
